settings.title: What it is
settings.text: A daily softgel with pumpkin seed oil, the same oil that's in our nightly scalp serum. Because you take it by mouth, it reaches your whole scalp, not just the areas you apply the serum to.

settings.title: How to take it
settings.text:
Take your softgels each day with a meal, as directed on the bottle. Hair grows in cycles, so give it at least 3 months of daily use.

If you're pregnant, breastfeeding, taking medication or have a medical condition, check with your doctor before starting any supplement.

settings.title: Using it with the serum
settings.text: For thinning across your whole head, take the capsules every day and keep using the serum each night on the areas you notice most. The capsules work from the inside, and the serum works directly on your scalp.
